headline: Should You Buy Adobe Stock For Its Cash?
summary: Over the last twelve months, Adobe (ADBE) produced free cash flow equal to 11.1% of its market value. By comparison, the median S&P 500 company sits at 4.4%. A yield that high usually signals one of two things: the business is on sale, or buyers expect it to shrink. Is that cash really yours, and how solid is it.
